rows.reasoning: Kavanagh sponsored SB 1294 (leasing a state prison to detain 'criminal illegal aliens') and SB 1610 (requiring county jails to supply ICE with inmate information), and his own quotes frame these as 'supporting the federal government's deportation efforts.' This shows a pro-enforcement direction toward criminal and arrested populations, but it does not establish whether he holds the rung 'Only deport undocumented immigrants convicted of serious violent crimes,' the rung 'Deport all undocumented immigrants, starting with those who have criminal records,' or the mass-deportation rung covering 'long-settled families and workers.'

quotes.text: The federal government should have access to the empty Marana Prison to house these dangerous criminal illegal aliens so that Arizonans are protected from further threats
Detention centers are running at max capacity, and as a result, illegal aliens are being released back into communities.
With this bill, we are supporting the federal government's deportation efforts by requiring detention facilities to supply inmate information to ICE.
